question.text: Equity derivative trading in India was introduced with the launch of:

answer.text: Index futures in June 2000 by BSE and NSE
Stock options in January 1995 by BSE
Currency futures in August 2008 by NSE
Commodity futures in November 2003 by MCX

explanation.text: The Logic: Derivative contracts in Indian stock exchanges began trading in June 2000 when index futures were introduced by BSE and NSE. In 2001, index options, stock options, and futures on individual stocks followed. The Trap: Stock options came in 2001, not before index futures. Commodity futures are a separate segment. Note: The chronological sequence from the source is: index futures (June 2000) -> index options, stock options, stock futures (2001).
